name: Tracklist Gallery
pitch: Minimalist editorial tracklist gallery mapping scroll progression to album artwork crossfades and audio metadata.

lifecycle.idle: First track title highlighted with resting album artwork and artist metadata.
lifecycle.discovery: Scroll triggers vertical title movement and crossfade to second track artwork.
lifecycle.buildUp: Progressive title scrolling smoothly drives progress slider and artwork transitions.
lifecycle.peak: Center-focused track title active with full opacity artwork and playback metadata.
lifecycle.recovery: Scrolling up smoothly reverses track focus and artwork crossfades.
